The main takeaway from our work is that
corporate governance is an important factor in firm value, both in emerging and developed markets, but the mechanisms are different.
corporate governance affects firm value in Korea by affecting firm behavior in two broad channels, and that board structure plays a particularly important role in both channels.
corporate governance in emerging markets can be associated with higher firm value, and this higher value is driven in part by improved firm behavior and in part by higher dividends.
